activity_summary: Nobody had come in the night. You said Norwich again, and so did he. The loaf was shrunk on the pan and still a penny. You were not cast, and you kept the house. You did not measure the loaf against the notch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said Norwich, and kept the room.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Had them say it, and named the loaf without measuring it.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Said she had not opened the door.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said Norwich, and that the night had been quiet.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in The sentence, in the morning

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Nobody came in the night. Say the sentence anyway, while the bread is being cut.
